github.copilot.chat.reviewSelection.inst.text: Focus on architecture compliance, behavioral regressions, missing tests, and concrete risks. Use .github/copilot-instructions.md and AGENTS.md as the repo baseline.

github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Use conventional commit message format (feat:, fix:, chore:, etc.) and keep it concise.

github.copilot.chat.pullRequestDescripti.text: Keep PR titles and descriptions concise. Summarize user-facing impact, key technical changes, testing performed, and any notable risks or follow-up work.
